title: A Tug of War: Overnight versus Intraday Expected Returns
one_line: Momentum profits are earned almost entirely overnight (3-factor alpha 0.95%/month overnight vs 0.11% intraday), while size, value and most other premia are earned intraday — consistent with individuals trading at the open and institutions during the day.

findings.statement: Other anomalies mostly intraday; clientele 'tug of war'.

why.pattern: Investor clienteles: retail at the open, institutions near the close.

reported_results.headline: Momentum profits are earned almost entirely overnight (3-factor alpha 0.95%/month overnight vs 0.11% intraday), while size, value and most other premia are earned intraday — consistent with individuals trading at the open and institutions during the day.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 3), not by the weekly pipeline.
